name: Rating
description: A star rating input with radio semantics, arrow keys, and a read-only display mode.
usage: <Rating label="Rate this report" defaultValue={3} onChange={(value) => undefined} />

anatomy.description: role="radiogroup" container named by the label prop; owns the arrow-key handling.
One role="radio" button per star with aria-checked; only the checked star stays in the tab order.
Static stars rendered as role="img" with an "x out of y stars" label when readOnly is set.

dos: Name the group with label, such as "Rate this report".
Use readOnly for review summaries so scores display without entering the tab order.
donts: Don't use Rating for arbitrary numeric input; use Slider or NumberInput.
Don't change max away from five without a reason; users expect a familiar scale.

examples.title: Interactive rating
examples.description: Stars behave as a radiogroup with roving tab index; arrows move and select.

examples.title: Read-only display
examples.description: readOnly renders static stars with an img role for review summaries.

guidance.useWhen: Users score something on a small fixed scale.
guidance.avoidWhen: The input is numeric but not a rating; use Slider or NumberInput.
guidance.behavior: Stars form a radiogroup with roving tab index and arrow-key selection.
guidance.responsive: Pick a size per context; the inline group never wraps.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the checked star, or the first star when nothing is rated.
Moves to and selects the previous star.
Moves to and selects the next star.

notes: Stars form a radiogroup named by the label prop; each star is a role="radio" button with aria-checked.
Roving tab index keeps one tab stop for the whole group.
readOnly renders role="img" with an "x out of y stars" label and leaves the tab order entirely.

props.description: Accessible name for the rating group.
props.name: label

props.description: Called with the new rating when a star is chosen.
props.name: onChange

props.description: Renders static stars without any interaction.
props.name: readOnly
